_comment: Guardrails for the rusty-workflow (CONSTITUTION.md). enforce-phase-gate: gated paths change only inside an implementing pipeline or under a waiver. enforce-secrets: no credential-looking bytes are written. enforce-commit-gate: no commit of gated files without a matching bin/gate.sh receipt, no delivery of a completed pipeline without a matching OpenWiki completion receipt, never --no-verify. record-pipeline-tool-use: an openwiki_finish that returns complete writes that completion receipt. Hooks are guardrails; the receipts are the proof.
